title: Learn to dance in 10 minutes - easy partner dance basics

method.teacher_system: Brian introduces the waltz box step by breaking down footwork for ladies and men separately in solo practice. He has learners count and step through the patterns before combining partners together for partner waltz practice.
method.signature: Instructing men and women to practice their separate roles in isolated groups before pairing up for the waltz.

practices.what: Introduce the box step for ladies starting with the right foot back, side, and close.
Practice the ladies' box step while counting 1, 2, 3 and transferring weight.
Teach the gentlemen's box step starting with the left foot forward, side, and close.
Practice the solo box step routine in separate groups before partnering.
Demonstrate and explain the partner dance hold and hand placement.
Put the full box step together with partners in pairs across the room.

adaptations.difficulty: Side step is too large, causing trouble closing the feet.
adaptations.adjustment: Keep the step small enough to get weight from foot to foot.

beliefs.belief: Anyone can learn to dance the waltz in a single class.
The goal is social dancing, not professional performance.
If it is comfortable for you and you can get through the steps, it is working.

feelings.response: The teacher makes a joke to reassure the learners.
The teacher demonstrates the mistake and explains why it happens.

moments.says: The teacher asks how many people have never danced the waltz before.
The teacher promises the learners they can go from complete novices to feeling comfortable dancing the waltz in one class.
The teacher makes a joke about his own dancing to lighten the mood.
The teacher asks the learners to check which foot is free after a step.
The teacher asks the learners to say the counts out loud with him.
The teacher gives a specific instruction to move straight forward instead of diagonally.
The teacher explains that a side step that is too large makes it hard to close the feet.
The teacher demonstrates the common mistake of being nervous about stepping on a partner's foot.
The teacher encourages the learners to think about stepping on their partner's foot to avoid the mistake.
The teacher celebrates that the learners are already dancing the waltz and asks them to applaud themselves.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and confident that they can learn to dance quickly.

struggles.theme: Never danced before and feeling nervous
Having two left feet and lacking rhythm

clicked.theme: Easy to follow and clear explanations
Humor keeps everyone relaxed and not nervous

requests.theme: Want instructor to visit the UK
Wish to get husband to watch and learn

meant.theme: Gave confidence to dance on a cruise
Brought back memories of past dance days

method.limits: Audio and visual capture do not show individual partner corrections in close detail during the final group dance.
